subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should this narrow Control UI Sessions-list preview land independently, or be folded into the broader sessions overview design work?
rationale: The backend and TUI already support last-message previews, but the visible Control UI list design overlaps with broader open issues about session overview, titles, sorting, and peek behavior.

options.title: Land the narrow list preview
options.body: Review the linked implementation PR or a focused replacement that reuses includeLastMessage and renders a compact preview in the existing Sessions table.

options.title: Fold into broader Sessions overview
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the broader overview direction and close the narrow PR only after naming the canonical design issue.

options.title: Do not add previews now
options.body: Leave the table as a technical session-management view and close the paired PR with a maintainer-stated UX rationale.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow list preview
recommendation.body: Review the linked implementation PR or a focused replacement that reuses includeLastMessage and renders a compact preview in the existing Sessions table.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI Sessions work and older session-preview history make this the best available routing candidate for the UI/product decision.
